name: aurostack
description: House project templates and the generator that stamps them out.

plugins.name: stacks
plugins.description: Scaffold new projects from house templates: a NestJS API, a single-app React frontend, a Turborepo React monorepo, a Node worker and a Python worker. Templates are subtractive — each one is a complete runnable app with every optional feature switched on, and generating a project deletes what you did not pick. Includes the `stack` CLI (plain Node, no dependencies, no build step).
